sentences.text: In a small town, there was a boy named Leo.
He loved to learn about the world.
One day, his teacher, Mrs. Green, talked about water.
He thought about what Mrs. Green said.
He wanted to make a plan.
The next day, Leo took a big bucket.
He hoped it would rain soon.
Leo also checked the tap in the kitchen.
Leo asked his dad for help.
On Saturday, Leo had an idea.
He wanted to tell his friends about water conservation.
He invited them to his house.
They came with snacks and drinks.
It is called the Water Quest!"
"How much water do we use to brush our teeth?" he asked.
Leo told them, "We use only a little!
They learned to take shorter showers.
They learned to use a broom instead of a hose to clean the yard.
They learned to water plants in the evening.
After the game, Leo and his friends made a poster.
They drew pictures of water drops and flowers.
They put the poster in the school.
His friends saved water at home.
The town started to save water too.
One day, Mrs. Green came to Leo.
She smiled and said, "You did a great job!
He learned that small actions can make a big difference.
Leo was happy to be a water hero!
